cells.rationale: The latest 10-year yield (Oct 16) is 5.09%, just below the 5.10% threshold. With five trading days remaining until Oct 23, recent volatility (weekly range ~29 bps) makes a move of a few basis points likely, but the slight downtrend and market pricing of a Fed pause (83% chance) tilt the odds modestly toward staying at or below 5.10%. The base rate for October shows 9 of 11 prints above 5.10%, but the last two were 5.10% and 5.09%, indicating a recent shift. A sharp move on inflation, growth, or geopolitical news could easily flip the outcome.

note: Judge panel member forecasting from Claude's evidence brief before each cutoff; scored as a separate method.
